resources.string: Screenshot Assistant

Detects when a WhatsApp conversation is open so Screenshot Assistant can capture the screen and prepare the image for sharing. It reads only screen element identifiers and the conversation title (to avoid sending to the wrong chat). It never reads message text, never sends anything, and works offline.
